init.title: Set up work area
init.imperative: Run: python <commander-skill-dir>/scripts/init_work_area.py <work-id>. Start the work branch per repo guidance.

context.title: Load baseline context
context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, docs/agents/engine-config.json. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context, glossary, engine config loaded

understand.title: Understand the ask
understand.imperative: In your own context (the interrogator must reach the human), load constellation-interrogator and drive interrogation.json with the request, context, and commander starting questions; save the consolidated problem statement. Confirm it with the human.

postconditions.statement: problem statement and protected intent confirmed

plan.title: Author the gate plan
plan.imperative: Frame the bounded problem against the architecture packets. Author the gate plan into execute.json: each gate the smallest reasonable bite, with close criteria and required evidence. Get the human to approve it.

compact.title: Compact context and reload skills
compact.imperative: Run /compact to compress conversation context. Then reload the constellation-commander skill into this context. Confirm it is active before proceeding to execute.

postconditions.statement: commander skill reloaded in this context

execute.title: Execute the plan
execute.imperative: Drive execute.json gate by gate in this conversation using this skill's gate execution instructions. Dispatch subagents only for the implementer and reviewer tasks within each gate. If a gate proves the plan wrong, surface the decision to the user before continuing.

postconditions.statement: every gate closed with integrated evidence

reconcile.title: Reconcile the map
reconcile.imperative: Hand the implemented changes to a subagent that invokes constellation-cartographer to fold them into the recorded architecture.

triage.title: Route future work
triage.imperative: Load the constellation-triage skill into this context. Drive triage on execute.json triage_candidates in this conversation — do not dispatch a subagent. Before creating any issues, present the full list of recommendations to the human and get explicit approval for each issue to be filed.

postconditions.statement: every triage candidate routed or recorded

review.title: Review accomplishments with user
review.imperative: Summarize all gates closed, changes implemented, architecture changes reconciled, and triage items routed or filed. Present the full run summary to the user. Get their confirmation before archiving.

feedback.title: Record workflow feedback
feedback.imperative: Before committing, reflect honestly on how this run actually went: how closely you followed the skills, handoffs, and checklists; where you had to improvise or work around the instructions; what was ambiguous, missing, or contradictory; and what would have helped. Append one dated entry for this work-id to .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md (create it from templates/AGENT_FEEDBACK.template.md if absent — prefer the project copy under .agent-work/templates/, fall back to the bundled workbench template). This log persists across runs and is never archived with the work-id. Route concrete interface fixes to the closeout Template Update Candidates table and recurring signals to a Charter refresh. Then run the feedback invariant check before advancing: python <commander-skill-dir>/scripts/verify_agent_feedback.py <work-id> --phase feedback.

postconditions.statement: durable feedback log exists, contains this work id, and is not inside the work area or archive

archive.title: Archive, commit, and push
archive.imperative: Commit all remaining work, including the appended .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md entry. Push the branch to remote. Move .agent-work/<work-id>/ to .agent-work/archive/<date>-<work-id>/, leaving the unified AGENT_FEEDBACK.md at the agent-work root. Run the archive-phase feedback invariant check before marking archive complete: python <commander-skill-dir>/scripts/verify_agent_feedback.py <work-id> --phase archive. Confirm the branch is clean and merge-ready per repo guidance.

postconditions.statement: work area archived and durable feedback log left at .agent-work root
